statement_notes.justification: This corollary closes the global-one-cycle question by a direct containment argument without duplicating the stronger relevant-component theorem.
statement_notes.gap: The former open question reduces to verifying that one global simple cycle forces every weak component to have cycle rank at most one.
statement_notes.consumer: The explicit-support backend may dispatch every global-unicycle input directly to \(\operatorname{UnicycleHandle}\).
